caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair centered on a plain, light beige background. The chair features a rectangular seat and a rectangular backrest, both shaded in a reddish-brown wood tone with darker streaks suggesting wood grain. The backrest is framed with small gold or brass-colored nails or tacks around its perimeter, securing it to the frame. The chair's frame consists of four legs with rounded, turned detailing, connected by horizontal supports, also featuring turned segments and simple squared ends. The perspective shows the chair at an angle, with both the seat and the backrest clearly visible, as well as the side and front legs and stretchers. The rendering uses fine, dark outlines and shading to give the appearance of depth and detail in the wood texture and joinery. No other objects or details are present in the image.
title: Cromwellian Leather Side Chair
